about: Proposed region definitions for detailed maps of the United Kingdom: 12 ONS ITL1 regions (nine English regions, Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland), one region each. See docs/REGIONS-UK.md.
review: Research by AI agents reading publishers' pages; not yet reviewed by a person. Page contents came back as summaries, not verbatim text.

codes.proposal: ISO 3166-2:GB codes GB-WLS, GB-SCT and GB-NIR for the three nations; invented GB-NE, GB-NW, GB-YH, GB-EM, GB-WM, GB-EE, GB-LON, GB-SE, GB-SW for the English regions. ONS ITL1 codes TLC to TLN are the alternative.
codes.why: Address index ids (engine/setup/manifest.py:72), installed files (engine/setup/install.py:267) and the map build (packaging/build_packs.py:1471) accept only two capital letters, so a hyphenated code needs a maintainer decision. GB-NE ends in NE, which is Nebraska in STATE_CODES.
codes.verified: ISO 3166-2:GB codes seen on Wikipedia; the ISO page refused the fetch. ITL1 codes read from ONS's ITL1_JAN_2025_UK_NC feature service; not confirmed as the latest ITL edition.

water.dataset: OSM waterways and water areas (Geofabrik United Kingdom extract)
water.notes: united-kingdom-261116.osm.pbf, 2,287,716,144 bytes; includes Northern Ireland. The great-britain extract excludes it.
Great Britain only; GeoPackage 52,461,242 bytes; updated April and October.

dams.dataset: Inventory of reservoirs amounting to 90% of total UK storage
dams.notes: 273 reservoirs, CSV, published 2018. No current official Environment Agency register confirmed.

crops.dataset: No open source with orchard, vineyard or berry classes confirmed
crops.notes: Crop Map of England 2024 (RPA, OGL) is England only and has no orchard or vineyard class; UKCEH Land Cover Map 2023 is non-commercial and forbids internet redistribution; Scottish crop map 2019 has no fruit class or download found; Wales not checked; Northern Ireland none found. OSM landuse=orchard/vineyard not looked at.

buildings.notes: 2023 update added 7.6 million UK footprints. Do not mix with the Overture route.
Great Britain only, 1:10,000, generalised; GB GeoPackage 3,480,881,355 bytes.

places.notes: Great Britain only. Settlements, roads, postcode points; CSV 103,312,081 bytes; version 2026-10; updated every three months.
14 MB; carries a Royal Mail notice.

postcodes.verified: product page and API opened; coordinate fields not read
postcodes.notes: About 1.7 million postcodes, Great Britain only, quarterly; CSV 14,470,875 bytes.
Includes Northern Ireland, but commercial use of BT postcodes needs a Land and Property Services licence.

addresses.dataset: No open UK dataset with address text and coordinates found
addresses.verified: Overture, OS, Royal Mail and Finance NI pages opened
addresses.notes: Overture has no UK source; OS Open UPRN has coordinates only; AddressBase, PAF and Northern Ireland Pointer are licensed; council tax address lists released under the OGL are disputed by OS, GeoPlace and Royal Mail.

pois.dataset: OSM amenities as the US map uses them
pois.scope: Great Britain extract only (England, Scotland, Wales); extract date not shown; counts are nodes, ways and relations together

pois.notes: 23,034 in Great Britain. The BHF's The Circuit is not open; its terms forbid use for an app without written consent.

pois.dataset: Environment Agency flood areas (real-time flood-monitoring API)
pois.notes: England only; WGS 84 polygons and centre points; credit: 'this uses Environment Agency flood and river level data from the real-time data API (Beta)'. Live warnings need a connection.
Hospitals, GPs, pharmacies; geocoding from postcode or UPRN would be needed.

Met Office warnings feeds (not an open licence)

guides.source: Food Standards Agency, home food preservation
guides.verified: opened; general advice only, no tested canning times

postal_code.format: Six patterns: A9 9AA, A99 9AA, A9A 9AA, AA9 9AA, AA99 9AA, AA9A 9AA; always a space before a three-character inward code; Northern Ireland is area BT.
postal_code.pattern_note: suggested in this proposal, not from a publisher; needs testing
postal_code.verified: Wikipedia opened; Royal Mail guidance page refused the fetch

addressing.order: Premises (number or name), thoroughfare, locality, post town, postcode ("10 Downing Street, London SW1A 2AA").
addressing.notes: normalize() keeps only a-z and 0-9, so Welsh circumflexed letters become spaces; is_address_query() needs a number first; _parts() takes a postcode only as one five-digit last word; find_addresses() reads one addresses/<code>.sqlite named for a US state; tools/build_addresses.py keeps only country = 'US'. Checked in this repository on 2026-11-17.
